newsitem.title: CANADA: Air Canada regional pilots go on strike.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada regional pilots go on strike.

text.p: Pilots at Air Canada's four regional airlines went on strike in the early hours of Friday morning, the Canadian Air Line Pilots Association and regional airlines said.
Contract talks broke off Thursday afternoon, prompting the walkout by 900 pilots from Air Ontario, Air Nova, AirBC and Quebec's Air Alliance.
No new discussions are scheduled, the union and the regional airlines said.
The union said in a statement that 250 pilots were demonstrating at Air Canada's headquarters at Montreal's Dorval airport as of 0730 EST/1230 GMT Friday.
The union said the issue of access to fair and equitable work throughout the Air Canada system remained unresolved.

"The issue at the centre of the dispute is how the seniority of regional airline pilots relates to their access to other aircraft within Air Canada and its regional Airlines," Stephen Smith, president of Air Ontario, said in a statement.
